study_design: Prospective 32 independent reset clusters (16 per task), every cluster physically tested at 4 ACK truths and 10 original PPO physical controller treatments. Exact source frozen plus only truth scheduler, protocol filename and B threshold 0.95->0.60; no tuning after 311/312 outcomes.
preregistration_type: Pre-physics frozen 0.60 same-public score vs unchanged set-membership A and unchanged actual C, previously selected based on disjoint development and retrospective 301/302 analysis; NEW unseen 311/312 cohort only. This does not reset the history of model selection.
original_matched_public_FullPose_setmemb: identical historical empirical public eps and +0.002m nonwinner compatibility margin
matched_procedure: For each 8-reset task shard, execute four truth conditions consecutively within ONE Python process; before EACH trial seed Python random, NumPy and Torch using same original reset ID, then reset all 10 PhysX worlds; compare exact initial SOURCE projected observation SHA256 across all four truths for each seed; if any differ abort ALL paired inference. Confirm A/B/C actually dispatched identical native t2/t3 6D arm command and actually completed physical t4 neutral, and check physical SE3 achieved+hidden target position/orientation pre-t5 pair mismatch <=5e-5. Audit-only actual target never enters A or B decision.
stats_unit: 32 task/reset clusters; four correlated actual truth treatments PER CLUSTER, not 128 independent task samples and never 1280 independent robots
task_primary_endpoints: native fault nonexposure or action representability refusals
physical_vs_software_scope: genuine author-operated ManiSkill CPU PhysX native command applied/held, not actual dropped ROS/TCP ACK or physical robot
do_not_change_after_results: method weights checkpoint epsilon threshold controller chart
assert identical predecision actual public physical poses target states and t2/t3 native commands among A/B/C
0.60 exact B threshold, chosen before any 311/312 cohort outcome
Do not re-use 301/302 outcomes as new source
Do not change 311/312 reset IDs or add favorable cases
first_run_failure_policy: If exact same reset initial hashes or source-method-before-decision equality fails, label original preregistration invalid; retain original failed run, then only rerun with declared postfailure amendment (NOT pristine prospective). Do not delete failure samples.
claim_boundary: 0.60 score was previously inspected on old 301/302 traces, so current claim is prospective generalization under selected hyperparameter, not parameter-selection-independent discovery
Author-operated simulator; no external scientific adoption and no hardware result
All 4 fault truths per original seed correlated; 32 independent reset clusters
Equal task success in one sample does not prove statistical noninferiority
A and B identical public XYZ sample count and known delivered native neutral step; C must price additional sensing
Wrong confident full history must be reported even with apparent task success
If prefix mismatch, missing truths, stale source hash, or physics failure occurs, label failed source, never silently drop or tune
